description:
Hey there! My Name is Trevor! Thanks so much for checking out our channel. I am the owner of a retail BBQ and Fireplace store in Denver Colorado area. I started my business in 2011 and quick realized the need for a YouTube channel so our online customers could see product. The channel quickly grew to pass along our knowledge of all things fire. Heres what you can expect when you subscribe. 
1- unboxing review videos
2- comparison videos 
3- bbq tips and tricks
4- in home design videos for fireplace features
5- how to's
6- all things outdoor patio to enjoy your backyard

Our goal is to educate consumers on all products that can enhance or improve your living environment at home!

Make sure to subscribe! Or if your in the Denver Area. Visit our showroom today. 
7705 W 108th Ave #600
Westminster, CO 80021
